baseline_yes.description: Always buy YES at minute 1. The control group: shows what spread and fees cost.

momentum.description: Bet that the previous 15 minutes' direction continues.

reversal.description: Bet that the previous 15 minutes' direction reverses.

late_favorite.description: Buy the side priced as a strong favourite in the last few minutes.

longshot.description: Buy the cheap side (under 25c) and hope for a late reversal.

spot_lag.description: Spot has run away from the strike but the order book hasn't caught up: buy the leader.

reversal_z.description: Fade the previous 15 minutes only after an unusually big move, measured in volatility units.

momentum_z.description: Follow the previous 15 minutes only after an unusually big move, measured in volatility units.

fair_value_v2.description: Fair-value model limited to 25-75c contracts, with a choice of volatility window.

closing_value.description: Final 1-4 minutes: buy the side the spot price says is underpriced.

fair_value_bid.description: Made for limit orders: bid on the side the fair-value model rates above the current bid.

fair_value.description: Lognormal fair-value model vs. the order book; buy whichever side is underpriced.
